about: Behaviour levers: changes to what a model does (a prompt, a LoRA weight edit, a control vector, a neuron edit), each fit on one model file and measured as prompt + lever against the prompt alone. A recipe carries one in its levers list (by ref to an id here, or inline); report.js --check refuses a lever fit on another model file, a llama-server base arm that leaves a loaded adapter on, labels a lever with no prompt + lever vs prompt row UNMEASURED-ON-THIS-MODEL, and a gain inside session noise null. Prompt-only and lever-only rows are references, never the label.

huge_moe_tail.doc: Huge-MoE tail trainer: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1017 (q3kL0-13-q2k, 384 experts) block 39's MoE half + head in torch, the 384 routed experts (27.2 GB f16) in pinned host RAM, on a 24 GB Turing card. Forward gate vs the ik_llama CPU engine's own logits (128 rows of a real agent prompt), then 24 rank-8 LoRA steps (shared + all routed experts' gate/up/down, 68.6M params, 4095 positions per step). Attention of block 39 not ported yet (compressed-stream consumer: ds4_attention yarn rope + sink softmax over raw window and carried top-512 + ROPE_BACK), about a day.

Stranger smoke on Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_S (blocks 44..47, 20 steps of 1024 tokens, rank 8, attn q/k/v/o) from a clean dir per card, 2026-11-15. Two cards trained two tails at once from one dump; parallel-trained tails do not compose, sequential (second with the first frozen) does in torch.
